lines.text: You do not come crawling in.
lines.spoken: You do not come crawling in.

lines.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving. Into his courts with praise.
lines.spoken: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving. Into his courts with praise.

lines.text: Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
lines.spoken: Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

lines.text: That verse says enter. The way you enter a home you have been invited to.
lines.spoken: That verse says enter. The way you enter a home you have been invited to.

lines.text: Gates, then courts, then the door.
lines.spoken: Gates, then courts, then the door.

lines.text: And behind the door, a table that is already set.
lines.spoken: And behind the door, a table that is already set.

lines.text: But most of us have been standing on the step for years.
lines.spoken: But most of us have been standing on the step for years.

lines.text: Knocking politely. Offering to eat in the kitchen. Apologising for our shoes.
lines.spoken: Knocking politely. Offering to eat in the kitchen. Apologising for our shoes.

lines.text: And here is the thing He keeps saying, in story after story.
lines.spoken: And here is the thing He keeps saying, in story after story.

lines.text: There was room for you.
lines.spoken: There was room for you.

lines.text: Not room in general. Room at the table, with a place set, and a name written on it.
lines.spoken: Not room in general. Room at the table, with a place set, and a name written on it.

lines.text: There is a verse that makes people nervous.
lines.spoken: There is a verse that makes people nervous.

lines.text: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place.
lines.spoken: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place.

lines.text: So that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, friend, move up higher.
lines.spoken: So that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, friend, move up higher.

lines.text: On the first read, this sounds like advice about being humble so you can be praised.
lines.spoken: On the first read, this sounds like advice about being humble so you can be praised.

lines.text: But look at what is really happening in that room.
lines.spoken: But look at what is really happening in that room.

lines.text: The host is moving people up.
lines.spoken: The host is moving people up.

lines.text: That is all. The host walks around the table and lifts people.
lines.spoken: That is all. The host walks around the table and lifts people.

lines.text: He is not testing anyone to catch them out. He is looking for someone to lift.
lines.spoken: He is not testing anyone to catch them out. He is looking for someone to lift.

lines.text: The whole scene starts because Jesus noticed something.
lines.spoken: The whole scene starts because Jesus noticed something.

lines.text: He noticed how they chose the best seats.
lines.spoken: He noticed how they chose the best seats.

lines.text: We chose the best seats because we were afraid there would not be one.
lines.spoken: We chose the best seats because we were afraid there would not be one.

lines.text: That is the real fear. Not pride. Fear.
lines.spoken: That is the real fear. Not pride. Fear.

lines.text: And so we do the opposite in our thinking.
lines.spoken: And so we do the opposite in our thinking.

lines.text: We put ourselves last. Not with the humility of a guest who trusts the host.
lines.spoken: We put ourselves last. Not with the humility of a guest who trusts the host.

lines.text: But with the fear of a child who has been turned away before.
lines.spoken: But with the fear of a child who has been turned away before.

lines.text: There is a difference, and God knows it, and He comes for us either way.
lines.spoken: There is a difference, and God knows it, and He comes for us either way.

lines.text: Eight verses on, the same meal turns.
lines.spoken: Eight verses on, the same meal turns.

lines.text: He said to his servant, go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city.
lines.spoken: He said to his servant, go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city.

lines.text: And bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.
lines.spoken: And bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.

lines.text: The servant comes back and says, lord, it is done as you commanded.
lines.spoken: The servant comes back and says, lord, it is done as you commanded.

lines.text: And there is still room.
lines.spoken: And there is still room.

lines.text: So the master says, go out into the highways and hedges.
lines.spoken: So the master says, go out into the highways and hedges.

lines.text: And compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
lines.spoken: And compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

lines.text: Look who has to be compelled.
lines.spoken: Look who has to be compelled.

lines.text: It is not the honoured guest.
lines.spoken: It is not the honoured guest.

lines.text: It is the one standing in the hedge at the edge of the road, in the dark.
lines.spoken: It is the one standing in the hedge at the edge of the road, in the dark.

lines.text: Who has already decided they do not qualify, and has stopped walking toward the door.
lines.spoken: Who has already decided they do not qualify, and has stopped walking toward the door.

lines.text: Maybe you have stopped walking toward the door.
lines.spoken: Maybe you have stopped walking toward the door.

lines.text: I want to tell you what Scripture says about that, quietly, without any pressure.
lines.spoken: I want to tell you what Scripture says about that, quietly, without any pressure.

lines.text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.
lines.spoken: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.

lines.text: That is the whole transaction. You turn toward the house, and the Father is already coming down the road.
lines.spoken: That is the whole transaction. You turn toward the house, and the Father is already coming down the road.

lines.text: There is one thing this table asks.
lines.spoken: There is one thing this table asks.

lines.text: A table with a place for everyone is still a table with a host.
lines.spoken: A table with a place for everyone is still a table with a host.

lines.text: It is not a room without a door. It is a home with an open door.
lines.spoken: It is not a room without a door. It is a home with an open door.

lines.text: So there is one thing this table asks. And it is the same thing a family asks.
lines.spoken: So there is one thing this table asks. And it is the same thing a family asks.

lines.text: Come as family.
lines.spoken: Come as family.

lines.text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children.
lines.spoken: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children.

lines.text: Receive. Become. That is the whole door.
lines.spoken: Receive. Become. That is the whole door.

lines.text: You do not clean up and then come.
lines.spoken: You do not clean up and then come.

lines.text: You come, and He brings you in as a child of the house.
lines.spoken: You come, and He brings you in as a child of the house.

lines.text: At Abba's Table, we remember the table the way Jesus gave it to us.
lines.spoken: At Abba's Table, we remember the table the way Jesus gave it to us.

lines.text: Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them.
lines.spoken: Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them.

lines.text: And said, take, eat. This is my body.
lines.spoken: And said, take, eat. This is my body.

lines.text: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
lines.spoken: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

lines.text: He said, this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
lines.spoken: He said, this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

lines.text: There is no fence around this table, except the door you are already standing at.
lines.spoken: There is no fence around this table, except the door you are already standing at.

lines.text: The bread is not a reward for a good week. The cup is not a prize.
lines.spoken: The bread is not a reward for a good week. The cup is not a prize.

lines.text: It is a place set, for you, by the Host.
lines.spoken: It is a place set, for you, by the Host.

lines.text: Let us pray.
lines.spoken: Let us pray.

lines.text: Father, thank You for the door that is open.
lines.spoken: Father, thank You for the door that is open.

lines.text: I have stood outside it so long that I started calling it closed.
lines.spoken: I have stood outside it so long that I started calling it closed.

lines.text: I have knocked politely and offered to eat in the kitchen.
lines.spoken: I have knocked politely and offered to eat in the kitchen.

lines.text: And all the while the place was already set.
lines.spoken: And all the while the place was already set.

lines.text: Tonight I would like to sit down.
lines.spoken: Tonight I would like to sit down.

lines.text: Thank You that the Spirit who brought me to Your table is the same Spirit who calls You Abba.
lines.spoken: Thank You that the Spirit who brought me to Your table is the same Spirit who calls You Abba.

lines.text: Father. Thank You that I am not an honoured guest, but a child of the house.
lines.spoken: Father. Thank You that I am not an honoured guest, but a child of the house.

lines.text: And Father, for the one still standing in the hedge.
lines.spoken: And Father, for the one still standing in the hedge.

lines.text: The one who thinks the room is full.
lines.spoken: The one who thinks the room is full.

lines.text: Go out and compel them in.
lines.spoken: Go out and compel them in.

lines.text: Bring them home.
lines.spoken: Bring them home.

lines.text: In Jesus' name, amen.
lines.spoken: In Jesus' name, amen.

lines.text: He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
lines.spoken: He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

lines.text: There was room for you.
lines.spoken: There was room for you.

lines.text: There still is.
lines.spoken: There still is.

lines.text: Sit, listen, and encounter God. One story, one prayer at a time.
lines.spoken: Sit, listen, and encounter God. One story, one prayer at a time.
